name: Katana Extension
instructions: Set a cable pulley low and hold the handle in one hand.
Raise your arm overhead with the elbow bent and pointing up.
Extend your arm up and across your body, as if drawing a sword.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A cable overhead triceps extension performed with a rotation of the arm to emphasise the triceps.
